subject: Entity billing consolidation + EU tax pathing for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia@arcadiasys.com>, Marco D'Angelo <marco.dangelo@arcadiasys.eu>
Cc: Arcadia Procurement <procurement@arcadiasys.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Entity billing consolidation + EU tax pathing for upcoming renewal

Hi Sofia / Marco,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — excited to get the renewal and the Q3 capacity top-up finalized. Before I draft the amendment, a couple of billing / tax items came up that we need to reconcile so invoicing aligns with your treasury workflow: 

- You mentioned the EU entity split (Italy and Germany ops) and that you prefer consolidated invoices to HQ for treasury processing. To proceed we need the procurement PO that will be used for the renewed commitment and the VAT registration certificate for the invoicing entities.
- Can you confirm the desired billing cadence (monthly / quarterly) and whether the HQ entity will accept a master invoice while you internally allocate costs?
- Preferred net terms (Net30 / Net60) and whether Arcadia requires an invoice-level remit-to change or a payor/financial contact update.

If you can send the PO and VAT cert, I’ll route those to Sales Ops and Billing to validate tax treatment and prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) that reflects the consolidated invoicing path while preserving entity-level usage accounting.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: (none)

Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Entity billing consolidation + EU tax pathing for upcoming renewal

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the outline. Looping in procurement so they have visibility and can confirm the PO.

We are attaching the provisional PO (Arcadia_PO_2028_Q3.pdf) and the VAT cert for the German entity (EU_VAT_Certificate_Arcadia.pdf). A few clarifications:

- Arcadia is splitting commercial operations across two legal entities but treasury prefers a single consolidated invoice to Arcadia HQ for easier payment runs. We will do internal cost allocation after payment.
- Procurement would like Net60 on the renewal amendment. They will confirm formally if Net45 is acceptable, but Net60 is preferred.
- Remit-to will remain the same as last year; no new payor account.

Procurement — can you confirm acceptance of the attached PO and advise if you need the invoice to reference both legal entity names or only the HQ purchase reference?

Thanks,
Sofia Morales
Finance Lead, Arcadia Systems
sofia@arcadiasys.com

Attachments:
- Arcadia_PO_2028_Q3.pdf (application/pdf)
- EU_VAT_Certificate_Arcadia.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Entity billing consolidation + EU tax pathing for upcoming renewal

Tessa / Priyom — forwarding Arcadia's reply and attachments from Sofia (PO + VAT cert). Key asks from Arcadia: consolidated invoice to HQ, Net60, and confirmation whether the invoice can reference HQ purchase ref only while showing entity-level usage on the statement.

Can Sales Ops / Billing:
- Validate the VAT certificate and confirm whether we can invoice Arcadia HQ while crediting usage to the two legal entities for internal reporting (i.e., single invoice + two line-item legal references).
- Confirm whether Net60 is acceptable against our renewal terms for this deal (ARC-2891) and, if so, prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) that updates payment terms and includes the PO number and remit-to language.
- If we need to route invoices differently (two payors), flag implications on collections and revenue recognition.

Sofia asked for a fast turnaround to align with their month-end payment runs. I’ve added the HubSpot deal link and a DocuSign placeholder below.

HubSpot: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/ARC-2891
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/ARC-2891-amend

Thanks — can you confirm next steps by Monday so I can reply to Arcadia?

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 14:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Entity billing consolidation + EU tax pathing for upcoming renewal

Jasmine / Tessa — reviewed the PO and VAT cert. Proposed approach (two-step, minimizes ops work):

1) Bill HQ consolidated per Arcadia's request: we issue a single invoice to Arcadia HQ referencing the HQ purchase reference number and include an attachment/statement that breaks out usage by legal entity (line items tagged with LegalEntity: Arcadia-IT / Arcadia-DE). That satisfies treasury and preserves entity-level traceability for accounting.

2) Accept Net60 for this renewal amendment as a special term for ARC-2891 (we'll record as a negotiated payment term in the deal record). Finance is OK with Net60 provided procurement signs the attached amendment.

I attached the Entity_Split_Matrix.xlsx with the mapping fields we'll need from Arcadia (legal entity tax ids, billing contact, internal cost center codes). Please ask Sofia to return that completed matrix along with any specific invoice reference text they require.

Next steps for us:
- Tessa: prepare the amendment (DocuSign) that updates payment terms to Net60 and references PO Arcadia_PO_2028_Q3.pdf.
- Jasmine: reply to Arcadia with the two-step plan and attach Entity_Split_Matrix.xlsx for completion.

I'll flag the deal in HubSpot (ARC-2891) and add a note about the negotiated terms.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
